adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array across the codebase and updates GoogleCalendarService to select the destination calendar by matching `credentialId` (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), enabling multi-destination behavior. However, the generic CalDav `BaseCalendarService` in `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts` was updated to destructure only the first entry (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];`) and then uses only that entry’s `externalId` both when filtering calendars for event creation (~line 153+) and when marking calendars as `primary` (~line 504+). With `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now looping over all `event.destinationCalendar` entries but passing the same `event` array each time, CalDav-based providers will keep using the first destination calendar regardless of which host/credential is being processed, so additional destinations won’t be honored correctly.
